raw_segments.text: I divine then, Sonya," he went on eagerly.
"'That power is only vouchsafe to the man who dares to stoop and pick it up.
There is only one thing, one thing needful.
Then for the first time in my life an idea took shape in my mind, which no one had ever
I saw clear as daylight how strange it is that not a single person living in this mad
world has had the daring to go straight for it all and send it flying to the devil.
I—I wanted to have the daring, and I killed her.
I only wanted to have the daring, Sonya.
That was the whole cause of it."
